Add title text box, centered horizontally near the top (~5% from top): text 'What is Machine Learning?', Arial bold ~40pt, color #CC0000. 3. Draw a rectangle spanning ~9%-91% width and ~25%-92% height, white fill, no shadow, border: solid red #CC0000, ~2pt weight. 4. Inside the box, top-left with ~0.2in inset, add a text frame: first line 'Machine Learning:' in bold red #CC0000, ~24pt. 5. Below it add three bulleted paragraphs (round bullets, black text ~22pt, Arial): (a) 'Designing algorithms that can ' + blue #1A1ACC 'learn patterns from data' + ' (and exploit them)' — let the line wrap naturally with hanging indent; (b) bold red 'Approach:' + black ': human supplies training examples, the machine learns' (note: 'Approach:' itself is the red bold portion, following text black); (c) bold red 'Example:' + black ': Show the machine a bunch of spam and legitimate emails and ' + blue #1A1ACC 'let it learn to predict if a new email is spam or not'. 6. Leave the lower ~third of the box empty. 7. Do not add charts, images, or equations; optionally overlay a small pen-cursor icon right-of-center between bullets 2 and 3 only if replicating the recording artifact.
